messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: I prototyped per-tenant dedupe-window config and defaulted to 5 minutes. Need feedback - is 5m safe for customers who replay requests?

Sofia: 5m seems short for some enterprise customers; they replay request batches when they recover infra. Need per-tenant override and a max cap.

Claire: Also consider clock skew. Our fingerprint+ingest_timestamp approach should use kafka offsets instead of wall clock if possible.

Ravi: Good point. We'll use kafka offset + tenant watermark for dedupe collapse but still expose human-friendly TTLs in Console (5m default, configurable up to 72h).

MonitorBot: created ticket PLAT-4822 for dedupe-window rollout.

Sofia: Also surface dedupe metrics: number of deduped events and window hit rate.

Ravi: Adding metrics. Will run a small experiment in staging with two tenants at 1h window to observe storage and CPU impact.
